name: vector_search_entities
description: Search entities and relations by vector similarity over the serving chunk index. Finds the top-K owners whose chunks are closest to the query embedding, one row per owner, ranked by the best matching chunk. Result rows carry 'kind' ('entity' or 'relation'); a relation row displays 'from -> TYPE -> to' and its relation type in 'entityType'. Optionally narrow the owner set with 'filter' (kind and/or type) and attach the matched chunk text with 'includeChunks'.

embedding.description: The query embedding vector (f64 array, must match configured dimension)

filter.description: Optional: 'kind' limits the owner kind ('entity' or 'relation'); 'type' matches the owner type name exactly. 'type' without 'kind' matches either kind.

includeChunks.description: Optional: attach the matched chunk (kind, reassembled text, score) to each result row

name: hybrid_search
description: Combined vector + full-text search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, fused at owner level: the vector half ranks owners by their best chunk, the FTS5 half matches entities only, so relation rows enter the fusion with their vector rank only. Results are boosted by graph centrality whenever the graph mirror holds nodes, for entity rows only; there is no flag to disable the boost. Result rows carry 'kind' ('entity' or 'relation'). Optionally narrow the owner set with 'filter' (kind and/or type) and attach the matched chunk text with 'includeChunks'. queryText is never embedded: the vector half needs queryEmbedding.

queryText.description: Text query for FTS5 search against entity names and observations

queryEmbedding.description: Query embedding vector for vector similarity search

textWeight.description: Weight for text search rank in RRF fusion (default 0.5)

vecWeight.description: Weight for vector search rank in RRF fusion (default 0.5)

topK.description: Number of fused results to return (default 10)

filter.description: Optional: 'kind' limits the owner kind ('entity' or 'relation'); 'type' matches the owner type name exactly. 'type' without 'kind' matches either kind.

includeChunks.description: Optional: attach the matched vector chunk (kind, reassembled text, score) to each result row

name: vector_refresh_graph_cache
description: Rebuild the in-memory petgraph adjacency cache from the SQLite relation table. Use this after adding/removing relations via KG tools if you want the petgraph-based centrality boost in hybrid_search to be up-to-date.

name: vector_store_stats
description: Return statistics about the vector store: embeddingCount (chunk rows in the serving snapshot), dims, and petgraphNodes/petgraphEdges of the in-memory graph mirror used for the hybrid-search centrality boost.

name: vector_search_by_entity
description: 'More like this': search by the identity chunk of a given entity (its name and type), ranking owners by how close their best chunk is. The reference entity itself is excluded by default (excludeSelf). Result rows carry 'kind' ('entity' or 'relation'); a relation row displays 'from -> TYPE -> to' and its relation type in 'entityType'. Optionally narrow the owner set with 'filter' (kind and/or type) and attach the matched chunk text with 'includeChunks'.

entityName.description: The reference entity (must have an identity chunk)

filter.description: Optional: 'kind' limits the owner kind ('entity' or 'relation'); 'type' matches the owner type name exactly. 'type' without 'kind' matches either kind.

includeChunks.description: Optional: attach the matched chunk (kind, reassembled text, score) to each result row

excludeSelf.description: Exclude the reference entity from results (default true)

name: vector_mmr_search
description: Diversified semantic search via Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR). Retrieves a candidate pool (fetchK) for the query embedding, then greedily selects topK results balancing relevance to the query against novelty versus already-selected results. 'lambda' in [0,1] trades relevance (1.0) for diversity (0.0); default 0.5. Reduces near-duplicate hits — a standard RAG context-selection step. 'score' is the MMR score.

fetchK.description: Candidate pool size to diversify from (default max(20, 4*topK))

entityType.description: Optional: only return entities of this type

name: semantic_search
description: Search entities and relations by meaning, with text only. Send 'queryText' and the server embeds it; the client needs no embedding service and sends no vector. The server embeds the query with the model named by the serving index profile — the same model that embedded the stored owners — so the query and the index agree. That model comes from the [indexer] section of the server configuration file, never from this call. Returns the topK owners whose best chunks are closest to the query, one row per owner; result rows carry 'kind' ('entity' or 'relation') and a relation row displays 'from -> TYPE -> to' with its relation type in 'entityType'. Optionally narrow the owner set with 'filter' (kind and/or type) and attach the matched chunk text with 'includeChunks'. Set 'textWeight' or 'vecWeight' to fuse the vector result with the FTS5 text result, exactly as 'hybrid_search' does; leave both unset for a pure vector search. The server must be built with the 'indexer' feature and must have a configured embedding provider. Without either one the tool is absent from tools/list and a call to it is refused.

queryText.description: The text to search for. The server embeds this text itself.

filter.description: Optional: 'kind' limits the owner kind ('entity' or 'relation'); 'type' matches the owner type name exactly. 'type' without 'kind' matches either kind.

includeChunks.description: Optional: attach the matched chunk (kind, reassembled text, score) to each result row

textWeight.description: Optional weight for the FTS5 text rank (default 0.5). Setting this or 'vecWeight' turns on fusion.

vecWeight.description: Optional weight for the vector rank (default 0.5). Setting this or 'textWeight' turns on fusion.
